q: How much CO2 does making hydrogen from natural gas release per kilogram?
title: Grey hydrogen: CO2 per kg
short: The reforming chemistry alone releases 5.5 kg of CO2 per kg of hydrogen. Adding the gas burnt to heat the reformer usually takes the total to roughly 9 to 10 kg per kg. Use your own gas meters for both feed and fuel rather than a published average.
audience: Refineries, fertiliser plants and chemical units running steam methane reformers, and buyers comparing grey and green hydrogen

ul: Feed: methane and steam become hydrogen and CO2. Per kg of hydrogen that is 5.5 kg of CO2, fixed by chemistry.
Fuel: natural gas or off gas burnt to heat the reformer tubes adds the rest.
Power and steam bought in add indirect emissions.

p: Take metered feed gas plus fuel gas, convert to energy with the gas analysis, multiply by the gas factor, and divide by tonnes of hydrogen made. Credit only CO2 that is captured and stored or sold into a product with contracts.
India's Green Hydrogen Standard sets 2 kg CO2e per kg as the threshold, so grey hydrogen sits several times above it.

example.title: Worked example
lines: Feed CO2: 5.5 kg per kg H2
Reformer fuel: about 3.5 to 4.5 kg per kg H2 (assumed)
Total: about 9 to 10 kg CO2 per kg H2
example.note: The fuel share depends on the plant; use your own meters.
